A total of 9 non-hydrogen bond connections are counted.

method.method_draft: Make a one-by-one bond inventory excluding H: R-C lower-left, lower-left C-O, O-upper C, upper C-O of OR2, O-R2 inside OR2, upper C=C right, lower-left C-lower allylic C, lower C=C right, and right C-R1. Count these nine non-H bond connections to obtain 9.
